policies.name: Public can view images of published products
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_images.product_id) AND (p.status = 'published'::text))))

policies.name: Public can view styles of published products
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (products p
     JOIN styles s ON ((s.id = product_styles.style_id)))
  WHERE ((p.id = product_styles.product_id) AND (p.status = 'published'::text) AND (s.is_active = true))))

policies.name: Public can view tags of published products
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (products p
     JOIN tags t ON ((t.id = product_tags.tag_id)))
  WHERE ((p.id = product_tags.product_id) AND (p.status = 'published'::text) AND (t.is_active = true))))

policies.name: Users can view their own role

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.user_roles
    where user_id = auth.uid()
      and role = 'admin'
  );
$function$
